subject: FY26 Cross-Team DevTools Renewal: coordination and budgets
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FY26 Cross-Team DevTools Renewal: coordination and budgets

Team —

We need to lock down renewals for GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains All Products Pack, and our Atlassian stack before the end of Q2. Procurement asked that we submit consolidated purchase requests by 2026-05-06 so finance can process the PO and get the vendors scheduled.

Quick context: usage telemetry shows a ~12% seat increase across engineering orgs YOY; licensing for JetBrains is up for campus-wide discounts if we commit to 12 months. Atlassian has proposed a mid-tier support upgrade that includes faster incident SLAs; GitHub is offering a multi-year discount tied to our commitment to Reserved Instances for Codespaces (they've sent a quote).

Asks:
- Lauren: confirm seat counts for design/product (Jira/Confluence users) and whether procurement can cap at current seats + 10%.
- Maya: validate JetBrains active seat list and identify contractors who should be moved to floating seats vs. perpetual licenses.
- Dylan: confirm GitHub organization seat usage and Codespaces projected hours (send last 90d telemetry).
- Markus: can you run a quick risk check on Atlassian upgrade (SAML, SSO impacts) and flag any app compatibility concerns?

I've attached vendor quotes we received yesterday. Let's sync briefly on Friday (15m) to finalize inputs and give Procurement the signal. If anyone needs a different cut of the numbers, reply inline.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Engineering Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FY26 Cross-Team DevTools Renewal: coordination and budgets

Marissa —

I pulled the active seat export and attached a cleaned CSV (FY26_DevTools_Budget_Sheet.csv). High level: 1,420 JetBrains active seats (includes contractors flagged with @contractor emails). If we convert long-running contractors (>90 days active) to floating seats we can reduce the quoted seat count by ~85 seats. Let me know if Procurement needs the contractor agreement snippets for audit.

Two notes:
- JetBrains quoted a campus discount at a 12-month commit + 5% additional seats. If we want multi-year, their quoted discount improves but requires an upfront invoice.
- I flagged nine custom plugins used by infra teams that require JetBrains plugin license adjustments; license team confirmed compatibility in a test cluster but we should schedule final validation.

Attaching: JetBrains_enterprise_quote_2026.xlsx

-Maya
Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Productivity
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-30T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FY26 Cross-Team DevTools Renewal: coordination and budgets

Marissa / team —

Attached is the GitHub usage summary and Codespaces hours for the last 90 days. Key points: active organization seats 1,650 (org admins report ~60 orphaned seats that haven't logged in >180 days). Codespaces average concurrent hours currently at 120/day with cost trends stable; GitHub's reserved instance offer would drop marginal per-hour costs by ~18% but requires a 12-month commitment.

Suggested action: reclaim orphaned seats (procurement can reassign) and accept GitHub's 12-month reserved offer if procurement prefers a predictable monthly bill. GitHub rep (Asha) included a discount matrix; quoted file: GitHub_quote_Redwood_2026Q2.pdf.

I'll purge orphaned accounts on a short schedule after we confirm the list with team leads.

Thanks,
Dylan
Engineering Tools Owner
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FY26 Cross-Team DevTools Renewal: coordination and budgets

Quick security check:
- Atlassian support upgrade looks fine from an SSO standpoint; vendor confirms SAML metadata rotation window aligns with our IdP. We should schedule a pre-upgrade outage window for 30 minutes for Confluence shared spaces that use a legacy SSO shim.
- No data residency changes are required for these renewals.
- I asked Atlassian rep (Elena) for a list of apps that need re-authorizing after the upgrade; she said they'd supply by EOD 2026-05-02.

I'll draft a short playbook for the Confluence/Bitbucket/Jira change window and post to the INFRA ticket.

-Markus
Director, Infrastructure Security
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@github.com>, Tomas Ruiz <tomas.ruiz@jetbrains.com>, Elena Petrova <elena.pet@atlassian.com>, sourcing@procureco.com
Date: 2026-05-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FY26 Cross-Team DevTools Renewal: coordination and budgets

Thanks everyone — good progress. Procurement needs a single consolidated request by EOD Friday (2026-05-06). Action items and owner confirmations below: 

- Lauren: finalize Jira/Confluence seat cap and confirm any additional product seats (due 2026-05-04).
- Maya: confirm final JetBrains seat list after contractor reassignment (due 2026-05-04).
- Dylan: provide final GitHub seat count and confirm orphaned seat reclaim list (due 2026-05-04).
- Markus: post the Atlassian app compatibility list and change window to INFRA-1243 (due 2026-05-02).

Procurement (sourcing@procureco.com), please prepare a consolidated PO draft using the attached quotes. Vendors: Asha/Tomas/Elena, thank you — we may request contract redlines and standard SLAs; expect Procurement to route DocuSign next week.

I'll host a 15-minute sync Friday at 10:00 PT to sign off. Calendar invite sent.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Engineering Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: GitHub_quote_Redwood_2026Q2.pdf (pdf), JetBrains_enterprise_quote_2026.xlsx (xlsx), Atlassian_renewal_summary_2026.docx (docx), FY26_DevTools_Budget_Sheet.csv (csv)
